caption: The drawing depicts a single object—a weather vane in the form of a horse with a jockey riding it. The horse is shown in full gallop, with its legs extended forward and backward, as if leaping. The jockey, seated on the horse's back, is holding the reins and leaning forward. The weather vane is mounted on a horizontal and vertical rod that extends beneath the horse's body. The entire image is rendered in gray tones, suggesting graphite or charcoal on a light, off-white background. There are no additional objects or elements in the background, and the composition centers the horse and rider. In the lower left corner, there is a faint signature or text.
title: Weather Vane Finial
